ourMission.title: Our Mission
ourMission.description: Simplifying mentorship into open conversations. Anyone can share their experience with those seeking it, always for free.

whyWeStarted.title: Why We Started
whyWeStarted.paragraph1: Menvo was born from a simple idea: everyone deserves access to mentorship, regardless of their background or financial situation. We believe that sharing knowledge and experiences can transform lives and communities.
whyWeStarted.paragraph2: Our founder experienced firsthand the impact that good mentorship can have on personal and professional growth. However, they also saw how mentorship opportunities were often limited to those with existing connections or financial resources.
whyWeStarted.paragraph3: That's why we created a platform that makes mentorship accessible to all, connecting those who seek guidance with those willing to share their experience – completely free of charge.

community.title: Community
community.description: Building a supportive community where knowledge is freely shared and connections are made across backgrounds and borders.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: Making mentorship accessible to everyone, regardless of their financial situation, location, or background.

impact.title: Impact
impact.description: Creating positive change by empowering individuals through knowledge sharing and meaningful connections.

sdg.title: Commitment to Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)
sdg.description: We support the UN 2030 Agenda by fostering quality education, gender equality, decent work, and reduced inequalities through accessible volunteer mentorship.

ourTeam.title: Our Team
ourTeam.paragraph1: We're a diverse team of professionals passionate about making mentorship accessible to everyone. Our team members come from various backgrounds and industries, bringing together a wealth of experience and perspectives.
ourTeam.paragraph2: What unites us is our belief in the power of mentorship to transform lives and our commitment to creating a platform that facilitates meaningful connections.
ourTeam.paragraph3: We're always looking for passionate individuals to join our mission. If you're interested in contributing to Menvo, we'd love to hear from you!

ourImpact.title: Our Impact
ourImpact.description: These numbers represent real people whose lives have been positively impacted through mentorship connections on our platform.

ourPartners.title: Our Partners
ourPartners.description: We're proud to collaborate with organizations that share our vision of making mentorship accessible to all.

joinOurMission.title: Join Our Mission
joinOurMission.description: Whether you're looking to share your expertise as a mentor or seeking guidance as a mentee, you can be part of our mission to make mentorship accessible to all.

howItWorks.title: How Menvo Works
howItWorks.description: Our platform makes it easy to connect with mentors and schedule free mentorship sessions
howItWorks.metaDescription: See how Menvo connects mentees, volunteer mentors, and partner organizations in free mentorship sessions.

step1.title: Create Your Profile
step1.description: Sign up and create your profile with details about your background, goals, and interests. This helps us match you with the right mentors.

step2.title: Take Your Career Diagnostic
step2.description: Answer a few AI-guided questions about your goals and challenges. You get mentor suggestions tailored to your moment and can share the result with your mentor.

step3.title: Find the Right Mentor
step3.description: Browse our diverse community of volunteer mentors. Use filters to find mentors based on expertise, industry, location, and more.
step3.feature2: Search by location, language, or inclusion tags

step4.title: Request a Session
step4.description: Once you find a mentor you'd like to connect with, view their availability for the next 14 days and request a free 45-minute mentorship session. If the mentor doesn't reply before the time slot, the request is cancelled and we'll let you know by email.

step5.title: Connect and Grow
step5.description: Meet with your mentor via the automatic Google Meet link. Share your challenges, ask questions, and receive personalized guidance to help you achieve your goals.
step5.feature2: Email reminder on the day of the session
step5.feature3: Rate the session to unlock your next booking

step1.title: Create Your Profile and Request to Become a Mentor
step1.description: Your account starts as a mentee. Share your experience, areas of expertise, and the topics you can help with, and request verification right from your profile.

step2.title: Review by Our Team
step2.description: Our team reviews your profile information to keep the community safe. You'll get a response by email and in the platform's chat.
step2.feature1: No calls, all through your profile
step2.feature3: Approved, your profile goes public and verified

step3.title: Set Your Availability
step3.description: Set up your recurring weekly availability. Sessions have a fixed 45-minute duration, and the Google Meet link is generated automatically when you confirm a request.

step4.title: Conduct Mentorship Sessions
step4.description: Confirm or decline session requests, see the diagnostic your mentee shared with you, and track your impact on the platform.
step4.feature2: See the diagnostic shared by your mentee

step1.title: Create Your Organization's Page
step1.description: Talk to our team to set up your NGO, institute, or company's public page on Menvo, open for join requests or invite-only.
step1.feature3: Set up by our team together with you

step2.title: Bring Your Community
step2.description: Invite the people your organization serves and the employees who can be volunteer mentors. You approve whoever requests to join.

step3.title: Connect with Mentors
step3.description: Beneficiaries use the platform's same mentor catalog and AI career diagnostic. Your organization's mentors serve through Menvo like any other mentor.
step3.feature1: Same mentor catalog and career diagnostic
step3.feature2: Your organization's mentors serve through the platform

step4.title: Track the Impact
step4.description: In your organization's dashboard, see beneficiaries and mentors, who has completed the diagnostic, and how many sessions were booked and completed.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to the most common questions about the platform.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to the most common questions about the Menvo platform.

q1.question: Is mentorship really free?
q1.answer: Yes, all mentorship sessions on our platform are completely free. Our mentors volunteer their time to help others grow.

q2.question: How long are mentorship sessions?
q2.answer: Standard mentorship sessions last 45 minutes. This provides enough time for a meaningful conversation while respecting everyone's schedule.

q3.question: How often can I meet with a mentor?
q3.answer: This depends on the mentor's availability and preferences. Some mentors are open to regular sessions, while others prefer one-time meetings.

q4.question: What happens if I need to cancel?
q4.answer: We ask that you cancel at least 24 hours in advance out of respect for the mentor's time. You can easily reschedule through your dashboard.

q5.question: How do I become a verified mentor?
q5.answer: After requesting to become a mentor from your profile, our team reviews your information and replies by email and chat. Once approved, your profile goes public and verified.

q6.question: Is my information safe?
q6.answer: Yes, we take privacy and security very seriously. Your personal information is protected and only shared with those you choose to connect with.

q7.question: How does it work for organizations (NGOs and companies)?
q7.answer: NGOs, institutes, and companies with volunteering programs can have a page on Menvo to connect the people they serve - or their employees - with volunteer mentors, for free. Talk to our team to set up your organization's page.

q8.question: Can I be both a mentor and mentee?
q8.answer: Yes! You can have both profiles on the platform. Many professionals seek mentorship in specific areas while mentoring in their areas of expertise.

faq.supportDescription: Our support team is here to help you with any questions you may have.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Menvo, transparency and personal data protection are core principles of our voluntary mentorship community.

dataCollection.title: Information Collection
dataCollection.text: We collect information necessary to connect mentors and mentees, such as name, email, professional bio, fields of expertise, and scheduling availability voluntarily provided during registration.

dataUsage.title: Use of Data
dataUsage.text: Collected data is used exclusively to facilitate mentorship sessions, personalize recommendations, send transactional notices, and enhance community experience.

dataSharing.title: Data Sharing
dataSharing.text: We do not sell, rent or trade your personal data. Mentor profiles are public. Mentee profiles only appear on the mentee board when the person turns on “Public profile”, and even then they are visible only to signed-in mentors and administrators. On the board and on the mentee page we show name, photo, job title, bio, goals, areas of interest and the links you added (LinkedIn, GitHub, portfolio and résumé). Email, phone number and form answers are never shown to other users. You can turn visibility off at any time in your profile.

email.title: Email Communications
email.text: We send transactional emails related to appointments, confirmations, cancellations, reminders, and feedback requests via Brevo. You can manage your preferences at any time.

photos.title: Profile Pictures
photos.text: Photos uploaded to profiles are securely stored in Supabase Storage and used strictly for visual identification in sessions and public catalog.

storage.title: Storage & Security
storage.text: We apply industry-standard security practices, encryption in transit and at rest, strict Row Level Security (RLS) policies, and secure cloud infrastructure to protect your data.

googleCalendar.title: Google Calendar and Google Meet Integration
googleCalendar.text:
When connecting or booking a mentorship with Google Calendar integration, Menvo accesses Google APIs exclusively to create calendar events with Google Meet video links and verify schedule conflicts for selected time slots.

Menvo's use and transfer of information received from Google APIs to any other app will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements. We do not read, store, or share unrelated personal calendar entries.

mentorship.title: Session Confidentiality
mentorship.text: Conversations during mentorship sessions remain strictly confidential between mentor and mentee. Menvo does not record calls or monitor the contents of video meetings.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.text: We partner with trusted authentication and infrastructure providers including Supabase, Vercel, Brevo, and Google Cloud APIs, compliant with international data protection regulations and LGPD.

reengagement.title: Estágio Recife database
reengagement.text: Menvo started as an extension of Estágio Recife. Because of that, part of our mentee base comes from the Estágio Recife form: name, e-mail, and the answers given in that form. We use this data, based on our legitimate interest (Brazil's LGPD, art. 7, IX), only to send an initial invitation to get to know Menvo and complete their profile. Anyone who receives that invitation can, without logging in, ask to stop receiving e-mails or permanently delete their data and profile - the e-mail's reply link goes straight to that option.

retention.title: How long we keep your data
retention.text: We keep your data while your account is active or while it's needed for the purpose it was collected for. If your data came from a partner initiative, such as Estágio Recife, and you never access the account, it will be automatically deleted 90 days after the first invitation, with e-mail warnings 30 days and 1 day before deletion. If you asked to stop receiving e-mails, we won't send those warnings, and the deletion happens on the same timeline. After deletion, we keep only an anonymous record (a cryptographic fingerprint of the e-mail, which can't identify you) to prove the request was fulfilled and to avoid contacting you again (LGPD, arts. 15, 16, and 18).

rights.title: Your Privacy Rights
rights.text: You have the right to access, correct, update, or request permanent deletion of your personal data at any time via your account settings or by reaching out to our support team.

contact.title: Data Protection Officer Contact
contact.text: For questions, requests, or exercising privacy rights, please contact our team at contato@menvo.com.br.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: Welcome to Menvo. By using our platform, you agree to the terms and guidelines governing our free voluntary mentorship community.

usage.title: Platform Use
usage.text: Menvo is a volunteer, non-profit initiative that connects professionals willing to share knowledge with people seeking career guidance. Using the platform and every mentorship is 100% free. Charging or offering payment for mentorships arranged through Menvo is not allowed.

account.title: Accounts & Registration
account.text: You are responsible for the accuracy of information provided during signup and for maintaining credential security. Each user must maintain a single personal account.

inactivity.title: Inactive accounts and automatic deletion
inactivity.text: Accounts created from data imported from partner initiatives, such as the Estágio Recife form, that are never accessed will be automatically deleted 90 days after the first e-mail invitation. Before deletion, we'll send two warnings to the registered e-mail: one 30 days before and another 1 day before the scheduled date. To keep the account, just access it through the warning's link. After deletion, you receive a confirmation e-mail and can create a new account at any time. Accounts left without any access for long periods may also be deleted, always with advance e-mail notice.

security.title: Conduct & Safety
security.text: Any form of harassment, discrimination, charging for mentorships or misuse of communication channels is forbidden. Violations may lead to suspension or deletion of the account. To report behavior, email contato@menvo.com.br.

content.title: Open source and intellectual property
content.text: Menvo's source code is open source and released under the MIT license at github.com/paulpessoa/menvo. The Menvo name, brand and visual identity are not covered by that license and may not be used to represent other projects. What you publish on your profile and what is shared in mentorships still belongs to its authors; by publishing it, you allow Menvo to display that content on the platform for the purposes of these Terms.

communication.title: Communications
communication.text: By signing up, you agree to receive essential platform notifications, including booking updates, messages between mentors and mentees, and session reminders.

storage.title: Service Availability
storage.text: We strive to keep the platform reliable and available, though uninterrupted service cannot be guaranteed. We reserve the right to perform maintenance and updates.

rights.title: Limitation of Liability
rights.text: Menvo connects people but is not responsible for the guidance, advice or decisions that come out of mentorships, nor for participants' conduct on or off the platform. Mentoring advice does not replace specialized professional advice such as legal, psychological, financial or medical.

contact.title: Questions & Support
contact.text: For inquiries regarding these terms or to report an issue, please contact contato@menvo.com.br.

volunteering.title: Voluntary participation, no employment relationship
volunteering.text: Mentors and mentees take part of their own free will, at no cost, and anyone can stop at any time without notice or justification. Mentoring is unpaid and creates no employment, partnership, association or service relationship, nor any labor, social security or similar obligation, either between participants or between them and Menvo, in line with the Brazilian Volunteer Service Law (Law No. 9,608/1998, art. 1, sole paragraph). Accepting these Terms at sign-up serves as the agreement to take part in volunteer activity. Because the relationship is free of charge, art. 392 of the Brazilian Civil Code applies: whoever offers mentoring without receiving anything in return is only liable for damage caused intentionally. Menvo does not guarantee that every mentee will find a mentor or that a mentorship will lead to any specific outcome.

contactBetweenUsers.title: Contact between mentors and mentees
contactBetweenUsers.text: Mentors can see the profiles of mentees who turned on “Public profile” and reach out through the channels the mentee chose to show, such as LinkedIn. The first contact must be an offer of mentoring: say who you are and how you can help. Using this access for recruiting, selling courses, products or services, finding clients, spam or anything other than volunteer mentoring is not allowed. Conversations outside the platform (LinkedIn, WhatsApp, email, etc.) are the responsibility of the people involved. Menvo acts as an intermediary, and its liability for user-generated content follows art. 19 of the Brazilian Internet Civil Framework (Law No. 12,965/2014). Even so, we may suspend or delete accounts that break these Terms.

openSource.title: Contribute to Menvo
openSource.text: Because the project is open source, anyone can contribute code, copy reviews, translations, design or suggestions. Open an issue or a pull request at github.com/paulpessoa/menvo, or email contato@menvo.com.br. Contributions are voluntary too, follow the same no-employment rules in these Terms, and contributed code is licensed under MIT.

minors.title: Minimum age and care with minors
minors.text: You must be 16 or older to use Menvo, as declared at sign-up. People aged 16 and 17 can search for mentors and book sessions as usual, but they do not appear on the Mentee Board: turning on “Public profile” means declaring you are 18 or older. Mentors who meet with minors must hold sessions through the platform's meeting link, must not ask for personal contacts, and must not propose in-person meetings. Any suspicion of inappropriate conduct can be reported to contato@menvo.com.br, and the account involved may be suspended while it is reviewed.
